template: ts_decay_linear(if_else(or(greater(bucket(group_rank(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range({exposure_value}), 63), std=4), 20), industry), "0,1,0.1"), 0.8), less(bucket(group_rank(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range({exposure_value}), 63), std=4), 20), industry), "0,1,0.1"), 0.2)), signed_power(group_zscore(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range({exposure_value}), 63), std=4), 20), industry), 2), 0), 5)
idea: 改用向量极差(vec_range)衡量业务结构的最大偏离幅度以替代均值，通过分桶(bucket)机制仅保留行业内波动率排序前20%(极度不稳定)和后20%(极度稳定)的两端标的，中间状态视为噪音置零，并经5日线性衰减(ts_decay_linear)平滑降低换手率；构建专注于'业务结构极度稳定或极度不稳定'的两端极致策略，剔除中庸状态干扰。
expression_list: ts_decay_linear(if_else(or(greater(bucket(group_rank(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range(anl91_exposure_value), 63), std=4), 20), industry), "0,1,0.1"), 0.8), less(bucket(group_rank(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range(anl91_exposure_value), 63), std=4), 20), industry), "0,1,0.1"), 0.2)), signed_power(group_zscore(ts_std_dev(winsorize(ts_backfill(vec_range(anl91_exposure_value), 63), std=4), 20), industry), 2), 0), 5)
